journey.title: Account for something the reconciler found
journey.purpose: The safety loop. Something exists at a provider that this scenario has no record of, which is cost before it is a bug. The journey proves the reconciler reports rather than acts, and that an operator can quarantine before deciding, so a reconciler defect can never destroy a running node. It stays on the findings surface throughout, because a provider-only finding has no local instance record and therefore no instance page to open.

steps.intent: Notice an unaccounted count without opening anything, because unattributed cost should not require navigation to discover.
Read what diverged and in which direction. Present at the provider and absent locally is money; the reverse is a stuck meter, and they need different responses.
Distinguish an empty list caused by a clean sweep from one caused by a sweep that has not run, so silence is never read as safety.
Quarantine the instance, which stops it being a surprise without destroying the evidence of what it was.

Read the quarantined finding's own evidence in place: the provider it was seen at, the identifiers on whichever side is known, what differed, and when it was observed. A provider-only finding is by definition one this scenario holds no instance record for, so the finding itself is the whole record and the findings surface is where it renders.

Understand that the finding stays open until a person decides what it is, and that nothing on this page will decide for them. Adopting it into a record or removing it at the provider are both deliberate acts taken elsewhere, which is what keeps a reconciler defect from destroying a running node.
